newsitem.title: USA: Standard Financial Q1 net off as costs rise.
newsitem.headline: Standard Financial Q1 net off as costs rise.

text.p: Standard Financial Inc said a loss on the sale of securities, investment fees and a non-recurring legal expense adversely affected earnings in the first quarter ended March 31.
The financial services provider said net income reached $4.1 million, or $0.26 a share, versus $4.9 million, or $0.31, in the same period a year ago.
Standard Financial also said the loss on securities sales in the first quarter was $100,000 versus a gain of $1.6 million in the corresponding period in 1996.
The company's shares were up 1/8 Thursday at 22-3/4.
